section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments and protocols used to assess multiple variables in the study. Body Appreciation (BA) was measured using the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item scale with responses on a 5-point Likert scale (α=0.81). BMI was assessed through measured weight and height collected by trained nutritionists using digital scales and stadiometers, with BMI categorized into normal weight, overweight, and obese categories. Additional measures included background information (age, education, income, etc.), body weight satisfaction, weight loss efforts, and media use.
